envelope.description: Route same-operation immediate escalation to the lock owner

body.title: Route same-operation immediate escalation to the lock owner
body.summary: Implement the approved sc2 escalation forwarding/control lane within the short-lived manager. Preserve ordinary mutation exclusion while allowing an explicit same-operation immediate message to reach the live lock owner during drain.
acceptanceChecks: Use protected installation/operation/owner-session-bound endpoint discovery and same-user authorization; stale/wrong-phase/wrong-identity requests fail.

Owner remains responsive while waiting; duplicate/cross-window immediate intent coalesces and uses the original s4 instance/completion endpoint/nonce. Forwarder never mutates snapshots or steals/releases the owner lock.
Absent owner returns escalation-unavailable/uncertain and requires explicit reconciled recovery; never use PID/kill/signal fallback, timer-based escalation or competing replacement.

tests.name: cross window immediate forwards while owner lock remains held
duplicate stale wrong phase and dead owner escalation preserve exact completion nonce
